## TemplateEngine.MAX\_WIDGET\_ANSWER\_BYTES property

Maximum `<g-widget-answer>` data size in UTF-8 bytes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static MAX_WIDGET_ANSWER_BYTES: number;
```

## Remarks

Matches the Bot API `answerWidgetQuery` `data` limit of 1024 bytes (source: `https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answerwidgetquery`<!-- -->). Measured with `Buffer.byteLength` — character `.length` is wrong for UTF-8. Enforced at validation time on static content; `{{}}` spans skip the static check (runtime-enforced, mirroring the `<g-callback-answer>` static/dynamic split).
